bio: Peak Radiant in Valiant Protocol and Level 10 Face-It in Global Strike. If your crosshair placement is at knee level, swipe left. Looking for a real duo partner.

nodes.partnerMessage: Okay, quick question before we get anywhere. What's your main game? And don't lie to me, I can usually tell. 😭

choices.choiceText: Tactical shooters. Valiant Protocol and Global Strike all night.
Cozy sandbox games. I build dirt huts and harvest wheat in MineBlock.
Competitive games are a waste of life. Grow up.
Timer? Relax, we aren't in overtime on map three of a grand final.

nodes.partnerMessage: Okay, you actually play shooters. Respect. So are you a Phantom or Vandal person? And please tell me you know your smokes.

choices.choiceText: Vandal. Clean one-taps only. First bullet accuracy or nothing.
Phantom. Better spray transfer through smokes, zero bullet tracers.
I only buy the heavy sniper rifle and hold garage from spawn.
Lineups? I just run onto site, panic, and spray at the ceiling.

nodes.partnerMessage: Wait, you actually build dirt houses? 😭 That's kinda cute, but I'm definitely going to judge your survival skills.

choices.choiceText: Dirt huts are peak resource efficiency! Zero stone wasted.
Then coach me, sensei. My keyboard is ready for your orders.
You sound like someone whose bedroom smells like stale sour energy drinks.

nodes.partnerMessage: Wow, coming in with that attitude already? You know you're on a dating app, right? 😭

choices.choiceText: Just wanted to see if your brain functions outside of 120 FPS pixels.
My bad. That was an awful opening line. Can we please restart?

nodes.partnerMessage: Honestly, overtime is the worst. My heart's already going crazy by 12-12. That's basically cardio for me.

choices.choiceText: That explains the intense energy. What agent role do you main?
You need actual outdoor cardio, girl. Touch grass.

nodes.partnerMessage: Okay, Vandal. I respect it. Nothing beats getting that clean headshot when someone peeks you at the worst possible time.

choices.choiceText: Especially when it's against toxic duelists talking trash in all-chat.
What rank are you rocking right now? Be honest with me.
I bet you whiff 90% of your shots and blame hit registration.

nodes.partnerMessage: YES. Finally. People act like the Vandal is everything, but a good Phantom spray through smoke is so satisfying.

choices.choiceText: Brain over aim every time. Utility and positioning win championships.
You sound like someone who reads balance patch notes as bedtime stories.
Phantom users just can't click heads. It's a crutch for bad aim.

nodes.partnerMessage: Oh no 😭 You're the sniper guy? What happens when you miss the first shot—do you panic and pull out your pistol?

choices.choiceText: I never miss. But if I do, my secondary pistol tracking is lethal.
I panic-jump and pray to the gaming gods. Don't expose my secrets!

nodes.partnerMessage: You just run onto site and spray? 😭 Please don't do that in my lobby. I like living.

choices.choiceText: Teach me your discipline then. I genuinely want to learn from you.
It's just a game, stop acting like you're an Olympic athlete.

nodes.partnerMessage: Okay, resource efficiency is a fair argument... but if I see you still living in a dirt box after day three, I'm building you a real house myself.

choices.choiceText: Come into my server and build me a real fortress then.
I bet your base is just an over-engineered redstone monstrosity.

nodes.partnerMessage: My coaching fee is simple: one iced peach green tea and you actually listen to my calls. Deal?

choices.choiceText: Iced peach green tea is already ordered. What's drill number one?
What if I end up carrying you on the scoreboard instead?
I don't take orders from girls who spend 14 hours inside.

nodes.partnerMessage: Excuse me 😭 My room smells fine. My keyboard, on the other hand, is probably worth more than it should be.

choices.choiceText: Spending $400 on plastic clickers isn't a personality trait.
Wait... you're a custom mechanical keyboard nerd too?

nodes.partnerMessage: My brain's doing just fine, thanks. Your conversation is the part that's struggling right now.

choices.choiceText: Keep clicking circles in your dark cave, loser.
Okay, that was actually a witty comeback. Respect.

nodes.partnerMessage: Okay, that was better. Honestly, you'd be surprised how many guys immediately make it weird when they see I play competitively.

choices.choiceText: I hate that misogynistic trash. You're an athlete, simple as that.
Do guys really get that insecure when you outfrag them?

nodes.partnerMessage: Usually I flex between duelist and initiator. I like being able to entry when we need it, but I'll play info if the team needs it more.

choices.choiceText: A flex player?! That is literally the holy grail of teammates.
Wind-dash girl? So you bait your team and dash into walls?

nodes.partnerMessage: I promise you I'd survive outside 😭 I just happen to like ranked more than I like mowing lawns.

choices.choiceText: You're going to get carpal tunnel before you're 22.
Fair point. What's your favorite off-meta pick when trolling?

nodes.partnerMessage: Those people who type '?' after every kill are my favorite. Especially when the score ends up 13-3 and suddenly they stop talking.

choices.choiceText: The psychological warfare! You're vicious and I love it.
You sound like someone who holds grudges across multiple game seasons.

nodes.partnerMessage: I hit Radiant a couple acts ago. I'm around Immortal right now, mostly because I'm juggling school at the same time. And yeah, I'm Level 10 on Global Strike too.

choices.choiceText: Immortal while in college?! Your discipline must be insane.
Sounds like you have zero social life outside your monitor glow.
I'm hardstuck Gold, but I have god-tier comms and morale support.

nodes.partnerMessage: My headshot percentage is 38.4%, actually. So... maybe don't challenge me too hard yet. 😭

choices.choiceText: Stats don't matter when you choke under tournament pressure.
Damn, 38%? Okay, I'll shut up. That's actually cracked.

nodes.partnerMessage: Exactly. Good aim helps, but if nobody's giving you space or setting up the fight, it doesn't matter that much.

choices.choiceText: I'll be your designated utility support. You call the play, I flash.
Let's test this synergy. Where can we actually play together?

nodes.partnerMessage: Okay, maybe I'm a little too invested. I do read the patch notes when they drop. I like knowing why something suddenly feels different in-game.

choices.choiceText: That level of passion is wildly attractive to me.
That sounds like a mild psychiatric obsession, but go off.

nodes.partnerMessage: A crutch? Maybe. But I can still spray transfer when it matters. You'd have to see it before you judge me. 😌

choices.choiceText: Let me see you do it then. Prove it in a match.

nodes.partnerMessage: I'll believe you when I see it. Everyone's confident until the round comes down to a one-tap with a pistol.

choices.choiceText: Put me on your squad. I'll show you how it's done.

nodes.partnerMessage: Okay, at least you're honest 😂. Nothing's funnier than someone panic-jumping because they know they're about to get deleted.

choices.choiceText: I make people laugh even when I'm dying in-game.

nodes.partnerMessage: It's more work than people think. Between practice, classes, and tournaments, it gets pretty intense. You don't have to take it as seriously as I do, but it isn't exactly doing nothing all day.

choices.choiceText: You're still sitting on your ass in front of pixels.

nodes.partnerMessage: Deal. I'll build you something ridiculous and you're in charge of not touching my storage room. 😭

choices.choiceText: As long as the pagoda has a balcony for us to watch sunset, deal.
I'm stealing all your diamonds the second you log off.

nodes.partnerMessage: Okay, guilty. I made the whole thing way more complicated than it needed to be. It took me forever, but it works, so I refuse to regret it.

choices.choiceText: Fourteen hours?! You're an absolute mad genius.

nodes.partnerMessage: First lesson is crosshair placement. Seriously. Keep it where a head is actually going to be, not somewhere near the floor.

choices.choiceText: Harsh, but fair. What's drill number two?

nodes.partnerMessage: You carrying me? That's ambitious. 😭 But now I kind of want to see you try.

choices.choiceText: Talk is cheap on a dating app. Let's see it in the server.

nodes.partnerMessage: Oh, that tells me enough. I don't really want to waste my time with someone who talks about women like that.

choices.choiceText: Cry more about it.

nodes.partnerMessage: Okay, you're allowed to roast my keyboard, but I'm not taking a whole speech about how yours is superior. 😭

choices.choiceText: Imagine being elitist over plastic keys.

nodes.partnerMessage: Wait, you actually know keyboards? Okay, now I'm interested. Mine's a 65% with linear switches and a custom cable. I spent way too much time putting it together.

choices.choiceText: That deep thock sound is pure ASMR. You have elite taste.
I need to hear you type on that over voice comms.

nodes.partnerMessage: See? You can take a joke. Maybe this conversation has potential after all.

choices.choiceText: I'm full of potential. Test me in your private voice channel.

nodes.partnerMessage: Thank you. Seriously. It gets tiring hearing that stuff, especially when I'm literally putting in the same work as everyone else on the team.

choices.choiceText: You never have to prove your worth to me, Daisy. I see your skill.
Let them stay mad while you collect rank trophies.

nodes.partnerMessage: Yeah, pretty often. When I'm top fragging, some people suddenly get quiet. Then one mistake happens and it's immediately 'girls can't aim.' That's mostly why I keep my circle small.

choices.choiceText: Is there room in that circle for someone who genuinely respects you?
Sounds like you carry a lot of frustration from solo queue.

nodes.partnerMessage: I like being the player who fills whatever the team needs. But I'm not just sitting back either. Give me the chance and I'll still take the fight.

choices.choiceText: Brains, lethal aim, and selflessness. Where have you been hiding?

nodes.partnerMessage: Okay, I swear I don't. 😭 There was one time on Bind where my mouse cable caught on my bottle and it ruined the whole play. I'm never living that down.

choices.choiceText: Hahaha! Bungee cord for your mouse is arriving tomorrow.

nodes.partnerMessage: I actually stretch pretty regularly, so I'm trying to be smart about it. You can make fun of my gaming habits without wishing me an injury, though. 😭

choices.choiceText: Have fun getting replaced by an aimbot.

nodes.partnerMessage: Probably shotguns on eco. I love catching people who think they're completely safe because nobody would be stupid enough to sit there.

choices.choiceText: That is absolutely demonic. I love it.

nodes.partnerMessage: Honestly, once a team starts arguing with each other, you can feel the whole match change. Half the job is making them lose focus.

choices.choiceText: You're a tactical mastermind. Let's form our duo.

nodes.partnerMessage: Okay, maybe I remember people I don't like a little too well. 😭 But the IP thing is a joke. I'm competitive, not insane.

choices.choiceText: Remind me never to get on your bad side.
I'll be right beside you hunting them down.

nodes.partnerMessage: It takes a lot of planning. Classes, gym, practice, studying... some days I basically just move from one thing to the next. I don't think people realize how packed it gets.

choices.choiceText: That is wildly impressive. You have genuine work ethic.
When do you ever have time to date?

nodes.partnerMessage: I mean, I do have friends 😭. It's just that my schedule is pretty packed. School and competition take up most of my week, so I have to actually plan my free time.

choices.choiceText: Scholarship for playing video games? What a joke.
Damn. That actually shut me up. You're incredible.

nodes.partnerMessage: Honestly, I'd rather queue with someone who communicates well than someone with a higher rank who refuses to talk. Good comms make such a difference.

choices.choiceText: Then let me talk to you on private voice.

nodes.partnerMessage: I've clutched on stage with thousands of people watching. If you're trying to get under my skin, you're going to have to do better than that.

choices.choiceText: Whatever, nerd. Bye.

nodes.partnerMessage: See? That's better. 😭 I'll get you there eventually, but you're buying the drinks after I carry you through the first few games.

choices.choiceText: I'm sticking right beside you. Give me your OnlyYaps.

nodes.partnerMessage: You'd actually play support for me? Most people want to top frag. I'd honestly appreciate having someone who cares more about making the round work.

choices.choiceText: I don't need the glory. I just want to see you shine.

nodes.partnerMessage: This app is kinda terrible for anything longer than texting. The delay gets annoying. We should just use a proper voice channel.

choices.choiceText: Where do you run your voice server?

nodes.partnerMessage: Careful, you're making me like you. 😭 I might actually let you watch one of our matches from the private stream.

choices.choiceText: Front row seat with your banner in my hands. Send the stream link.

nodes.partnerMessage: Okay, when you put it that way, I sound a little insane. 😭 I just like knowing what changed before I queue.

choices.choiceText: Admitting it is the first step. Let's talk somewhere better.

nodes.partnerMessage: Alright, deal. But if you miss that shotgun shot, I'm collecting my two bubble teas. No excuses.

choices.choiceText: Deal. Now give me your comms link.

nodes.partnerMessage: See, that's what I want sometimes. Just playing and laughing instead of treating every match like it's the end of the world.

choices.choiceText: I'm here to bring the fun back. Come join me on OnlyYaps.

nodes.partnerMessage: Okay... a sunset balcony actually sounds really nice. Especially if you promise not to mess with my storage chests. 😭

choices.choiceText: Because I actually care about your peace. Let's make it real.

nodes.partnerMessage: Touch my diamond chest and we're going to have problems. 😭 I'm not joking about my storage room.

choices.choiceText: A dangerous girl. Exactly my type.

nodes.partnerMessage: Okay, maybe my friends had a point. 😭 But if you think it's genius, I'll take the compliment.

choices.choiceText: When do I start my shift? Send the link.

nodes.partnerMessage: Second lesson is comms. Just say what you actually know. Don't yell 'one HP' when the guy still has full health. 😭

choices.choiceText: Accurate damage numbers only. I promise.

nodes.partnerMessage: I'm warming up right now anyway. Come join me and let's see how brave you actually are.
Okay, you understand the thock. 😭 That's dangerous information. Most people don't care enough to notice the difference.

choices.choiceText: Only if we can have custom keycaps as wedding favors. Comms link?

nodes.partnerMessage: You actually want to hear it? Sure. I'll turn on my mic when we hop over there.
Stop 😭. You're going to make me emotional over a dating app. But... thank you. That actually means a lot.

choices.choiceText: I'm completely real, Daisy. Click the link and let's talk.

nodes.partnerMessage: Yeah, I have a few. I'm proud of them, but honestly the part that means more to me is knowing the work paid off.

choices.choiceText: Let's win the next one together. Send me the server.

nodes.partnerMessage: I think there is. I just don't let people in very quickly. So... don't make me regret it, okay?

choices.choiceText: Never. Let's hop over to OnlyYaps.

nodes.partnerMessage: Yeah. Some nights I close the game and just sit there because I'm too drained to do anything else. That's when I know I need a break.

choices.choiceText: You don't have to sit in the dark alone anymore. Talk to me.

nodes.partnerMessage: Probably in my room, honestly. 😭 I'm just waiting for someone who doesn't tilt after one bad round.
Okay, you got me with that one. 😭 I won't say no to a mouse bungee, though. You might actually win points for that.
I know. 😭 It's probably a terrible habit, but it's fun when it works. I'll show you some clips later.
Then stay on my good side. I give good callouts when I like someone. 😌
Okay, now you're making this sound like we're starting a crime spree. 😭 I'll take the duo partner part, though.
Thank you. I put a lot into it, so it's nice when someone notices the effort instead of just seeing the wins.
I make time. I just don't do the whole disappearing-for-days thing because I got busy with a match. If I like someone, I'll make room for them.
Hahaha, fair. I like that you can take the L and laugh about it. Come on, let's keep talking somewhere better.
Okay, that was really sweet. 😭 I actually like the idea of having someone there who wants to see me do well, not just tell me to win.
Deal. 😭 But if you jinx my ace, I'm blaming you. I'll send you the private stream.
Yeah, no. I'm not doing this. Unmatching and blocking. Take care.
Let's move this somewhere easier. Join my private channel and we can actually talk without this app getting in the way.
